item.title: Scrap Mechanic
item.description:
Title: Scrap Mechanic
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Axolot Games
Publisher: Axolot Games
Franchise: Axolot Games
Release Date: Jul 24, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Jan 19, 2016




About This Game

Scrap Mechanic is a unique multiplayer survival sandbox adventure with a ground breaking building system and physics!

Tool up and enter the creative paradise of Scrap Mechanic! Build fantastic machines, go on a full story survival adventure with your friends in this imaginative multiplayer survival sandbox. With Scrap Mechanic’s powerful creation tools you can engineer your own adventures!

‘Be a robot maintenance mechanic’, they said. ‘Easy money’, they said. We’re pretty sure the job description didn’t mention crash landing on a far away planet, with thousands of crazed worker robots out for blood! You’re stranded on a faraway agriculture planet where the Farmbots working the fields have gone haywire.

SURVIVAL MODE

In Survival Mode, players get thrown into an epic full story experience! Explore a dynamically generated open-world environment filled with enemies, treasure and dangerous robots! Team up with friends and build vehicles and bases to protect yourself and your valuables. All while uncovering the planet's dark secrets in a journey to the planet's core.

Surviving - Stay Alive, Stay Creative
Something has gone terribly wrong on this distant agricultural planet. With your tool belt tightly fastened, survival relies entirely on your quick thinking, creativity, and a clever knack for turning your surroundings to your advantage.




Building - From Scrap to Masterpiece
With Scrap Mechanic’s powerful creation tools, the possibilities are limitless! Build incredible vehicles for exploration, design automated machines, or construct a secure home to keep your valuables safe.




Farming - Produce of Opportunity
Cultivate, water, and defend your crops. Establish grand farms to harvest materials for your ammunition, advanced crafting recipes, and epic rewards, unless you prefer to keep them as a quick snack!




Fighting - Ammo from the Garden
A wild and dangerous world awaits, teeming with haywire robots. Prepare for dynamic encounters where you can test your mechanical creations in thrilling, inventive combat scenarios. Above all, keep your Spudgun at the ready!




Digging - Uncover the Unexpected
Discover the underground world at the abandoned mine. Attach drills to your creation and dig for treasure and secrets down to the planet's boiling core!




Character Customization - Drip meets Duct Tape
Dress your Mechanics and mix and match clothing pieces to create your unique look. Unlock new gear by completing missions, visiting vendors, or finding hidden garment boxes across the world, some much rarer than others.

CHALLENGE MODE

Put your imagination to the test in the Master Mechanic Trials, an amazing roster of 40 fun and testing challenges which every wannabe mechanic should master before embarking on the wide-open world. Plus create your own challenges and share them with friends!

CREATIVE MODE

Choose from over 400+ building parts and create a transforming vehicle, a walking house or anything you and your friends can imagine! Scrap Mechanic mod support offers an easy way to download over 1000+ new player made building parts for your creations!

item.title: Bookbinding – Dark Cozy Sim
item.description:
Title: Bookbinding – Dark Cozy Sim
Genre: Simulation
Developer: NDApolis
Publisher: Caspianborn Publishing
Release Date: Jul 24, 2026




About This Game

Decorate book covers to match customers' tastes – or your own, if you feel like it! – but remember: your actions have consequences. Some will appreciate your creativity, while others… might not be so pleased.

Meet many unique characters, each with their own personality and preferences. Find a way to learn their secrets. Who knows, maybe you’ll make a new friend? Or, if fate favors you, a soulmate?

Engage in conversations, open new dialogue options, and shape customers' destinies – for better or worse.

item.title: Mall Together
item.description:
Title: Mall Together
Genre: Casual , Simulation
Developer: Business Tycoon
Publisher: Business Tycoon , Gamersky Games
Release Date: Jul 24, 2026




About This Game

This is a first-person simulation game where you step into the role of a shopping mall owner.

Work alone or with friends to expand your humble mall into a huge shopping mall.

Co-op Mode and Single Player

Share the duties with your friends in co-op mode (up to 4 players).

You can also go solo and manage everything in the mall. If you change your mind, you can invite your friends anytime.

Workflow

Open new stores, sign contracts with leading brands, order new products, unpack boxes, place products into store racks, and set prices for your products.

Consider market prices when setting your product prices in the mall to ensure customer satisfaction.

Stores

Open new stores and make sure your customers find all their needs in your mall.

  • Bakery shop,

  • Supermarket,

  • Cosmetics store,

  • Tobacco shop,

  • Toy Store,

  • Bookstore,

  • Florist,

  • Video Games Store,

  • Sporting Goods shop,

  • Clothing store,

  • Hat store,

  • Footwear store,

  • Bag store,

  • Household appliances store,

  • Music store,

  • Tech store.

Customers

Scan products and collect payments, whether in cash or by card.

Don't forget to fulfill the online orders.

Expansions and New Teammates

Expand your stores and warehouses by leveling up your mall and budget.

Hire stockers to fill the racks.

Hire cashiers for your stores to minimize long checkout queues.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

This game contains AI-generated content on the game cover.



System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.

    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit | Windows 8 64-bit | Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F | AMD Ryzen 5 3600
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 | AMD Radeon RX-580
    • Storage: 3000 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit | Windows 8 64-bit | Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400F | AMD Ryzen 5 5600x
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 | AMD Radeon R9-290X
    • Storage: 3000 MB available space

item.title: An Eggstremely Hard Game
item.description:
Title: An Eggstremely Hard Game
Genre: Casual
Developer: BBear Studio
Publisher: Devotion Interactive
Release Date: Jul 24, 2026




About This Game

Two geese. One fragile egg. Infinite chaos.

Work together to carry it through unpredictable challenges without breaking it, every crack makes it harder, every mistake more hilarious. A co-op physics game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of honking.

Cracks = Chaos

With every crack , the egg becomes harder to control and easier to lose. Each impact makes it wobblier, bouncier, and far more unpredictable. Handle it carefully, or watch it explode in a glorious mess .

Not all is lost

When the egg slips away , you can still recover it. Every fall is a chance to try again. Fragile, cracked, but never truly broken.

Teamwork at its finest

Pick up your useless partner, throw them back on track, and pretend you didn’t almost drop them on purpose.

FEATURES

  • One egg, endless chaos – Keep it safe (or try) through unpredictable physics and tricky obstacles.

  • Cracks that change everything – Each hit makes the egg weaker and the game harder.

  • Teamwork and betrayal – Lift, toss, honk, and sometimes sabotage your partner.

  • Physics-fueled fun – Clumsy controls and goose energy combine for hilarious moments.

  • A true test of patience – Rage, laugh, and celebrate every inch of progress.

item.title: Some of You May Die
item.description:
Title: Some of You May Die
Genre: Strategy
Developer: Octavia Blue
Publisher: Octavia Blue
Release Date: Jul 24, 2026




About This Game

Some of You May Die is a strategic autobattler where you assemble a team of heroes and upgrade them to absurd levels of power. Take on the singleplayer campaign or test your skill against other players in Real-time Online PvP!

Breaking the game IS the game. Stack upgrades and heroes to level them up. Invest gold in customizing your heroes with full control over their stat sheet.

Want a high armor priest who reflects incoming damage? You can do that.
How about an assassin with lightning fast movement speed who skips your opponents defensive line entirely? Yup.

No two heroes are the same! Every time you are offered a hero, they come with a different combination of Boosted Stats and an Ability that give them a unique edge. These combinations create a huge amount of variety. After choosing a hero, you are offered dozens of highly synergistic upgrades to push the customization even farther. This empowers you to create ultra-powerful teams that feel completely unstoppable - until your opponent reaches for the perfect counter.

Key Features

  • Multiplayer and Singleplayer: Test your skill in Real-time Online PvP or beat the singleplayer campaign with 7 different squads and 5 difficulty levels

  • A Constantly Shifting Meta-Game: Each match has a different pool of upgrades to pick from and multiplayer games offer you a randomized squad of heroes too. This keeps the meta-strategy fresh every time you play!

  • Deep Customization: Each hero comes with 2 Boosted Stats (like health, attack speed, or range) and an ability. Boosted Stats start higher and upgrade faster than a non-boosted stat. This means that each hero offered in the shop has unique potential and some can be upgraded to absurd levels of power.

  • Become Overpowered: Stack heroes of the same kind from the shop to level them up. Leveled heroes get a significant boost to their stats, making each level a meaningful step up. Invest heavily in one or two powerful heroes or go wide and flood the battlefield to outnumber your foes! The choice is yours.

  • Stack your Upgrades: Level up your heroes' upgrades too! Upgrades offer a high variety of customization. Some add effects to your heroes' attacks like Poison or Stun. Some trigger actions on events like "on death" or "on kill". Leveled upgrades become significantly more powerful which leads to highly strategic and specialized builds.

  • Dynamic Difficulty: In singleplayer, if you lose a round, you lose a life, but you get to try the same round again with additional gold. This ensures new players get up to speed comfortably while still providing an exciting challenge for seasoned players.

    Matches are tactical, exciting, and will have you on the edge of your seat right up to the end! PvP matches often involve multiple "come backs" as the losing player gains traction and puts the winning player at risk.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Pixel art blood and gore



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10 or higher
    • Processor: An Intel Pentium 4 processor or later that's SSE3 capable
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 770
    • Storage: 360 MB available space
    Recommended:
    • OS: Intel i5-9600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070
